subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Which delegated Google identity, credential-custody, consent, attribution, and fallback contract should the bundled Google Chat plugin support for OAuth-gated operations?
rationale: The code can implement a chosen OAuth design, but only maintainers can decide whether OpenClaw should store a user refresh token, support domain-wide delegation, which operations may act as that identity, and how existing service-account installations upgrade.

options.title: Approve a narrow delegated OAuth contract
options.body: Define secret-backed refresh-token handling, scoped client routing, attribution, and absent-OAuth fallback behavior, then implement it in the Google Chat plugin.

options.title: Keep service-account-only support
options.body: Retain the current capability boundary and rely on text-link fallback for media cases rather than acting as a delegated user.

options.title: Require an external channel implementation
options.body: Defer bundled support until a separately maintained Google Chat plugin can own the delegated-identity policy and credentials.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delegated OAuth contract
recommendation.body: Define secret-backed refresh-token handling, scoped client routing, attribution, and absent-OAuth fallback behavior, then implement it in the Google Chat plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review context shows direct involvement in evaluating this exact Google Chat OAuth boundary.
